context:
Goal: fewer simulator crashes.
Problem (risk): iOS 27.1 simulators crash Siri and the intelligence services, and nobody has checked whether 27.2 fixes it, so trying needs a download and a new device on your Mac.
Based on (read): step sim-lease-gaps asks you before any runtime change.
Departs from: main runs Duos on 27.1 — option a adds a 27.2 Duo beside the old one.
Why yours: it installs software and uses disk on your Mac.

options.gain: A real test of the fix, with nothing lost.
options.how: A Mac session installs the runtime and creates the device. The skill's device names move only after it proves out.
options.label: Install 27.2 and make a new Duo beside the old (recommended)
options.lose: Download time and disk on your Mac.

ref: retrospective 21:53 CST Nov 12; Degen report plans/degen-report-2026-11-12.md
reply: Closed 22:01 CST Nov 12 by triage: your answer (i) in chat at 21:59 CST ("Q5 A"). Stored as ruling ios-27-2-duo; it goes ahead on step sim-lease-gaps.
short: iOS 27.2 runtime and a new Duo
title: Install the iOS 27.2 simulator runtime on your Mac and make a new Duo beside the old one?
why: It downloads and installs on your Mac, which only you approve.
